ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 95% of surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are limited to localized specular highlights from water/wetness.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous solid low-intensity distribution across both lobes; absence of large-scale contiguous high-contrast (white) mottling or geometric patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle; vertical depth approximately 1/6th of total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; left lobe exhibits a major macro-concavity/missing segment near the distal tip; right lobe displays continuous jagged saw-tooth peak-to-valley variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve from median notch to tips; left lobe trajectory is abruptly truncated by structural irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters visible along the outer margins and lower surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular structural loss/indentation on the superior margin of the left fluke lobe; multiple secondary jagged notches along the trailing edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'truncated' appearance of the upper left lobe corner compared to the tapering tip of the right lobe.
